purpose: Sanitized, provenance-aware context derived from the user's local iCloud Mail index. Raw message bodies, credentials, security artifacts, exact addresses, medical details, sexual content, payment identifiers, employee/applicant PII, and other unnecessary sensitive source material are intentionally excluded.

notes: This file records durable or repeatedly evidenced context, not a copy of the mailbox.
Automated marketing, recommendations, and job-alert suggestions are weaker evidence than sent mail, repeated behavior, confirmations, and direct correspondence.
Sensitive material was present in the source archive and was deliberately not copied into Git.

methods: Review of all Sent Messages subjects and correspondent patterns
Targeted body reads for education, employment, housing, travel, vehicle, technology, hobbies, research participation, and close-contact evidence
Repeated-signal checks across transactional and notification mail
Negative filtering for marketing-only, recommendation-only, stale job-alert, and sensitive-source signals
analysis_coverage.limitation: The indexed message text was exhaustively scanned, but 231 of 232 attachment records contain metadata only, so attachment contents such as resumes, leases, and forms were not available for semantic analysis.
analysis_coverage.attachment_content_status: The archive's indexed message text is exhausted for this pass. Attachment bodies are a separate future corpus because 231 of 232 attachment records expose metadata only.
